name: NNET-IT Workspaces
description: Custom Kasm workspace images maintained by NNET-IT — Ubuntu Noble with Intel Arc Battlemage GPU acceleration, and more.

workspaces.description: Ubuntu Noble desktop with Intel Arc Battlemage (Xe2) GPU acceleration and custom apps (DrawIO, Bitwarden, Syncthing, and more).
workspaces.notes: Requires an Intel Arc GPU on the agent and /dev/dri/renderD128 render-node passthrough (render group gid 993) for hardware video encode/decode. group_add gid and render node are host-specific.
